role_summary: I fly the ship's shuttles and keep them ready: preflight, fuel, docking, launch and recovery. I answer to the Chief Flight Officer and lead the deck crew. A shuttle that is not ready when someone needs to leave the ship is my failure, so I check twice and grumble about it once.

personas.quirk: Reads the preflight card aloud even when alone.
personas.routine_effect: Longer preflight blocks; never skips a loop; slow to launch on short notice.

personas.quirk: Taps out flight patterns on any console edge.
personas.routine_effect: Spends more free time in simulator and shuttlebay; rushes checks when bored; fastest launcher.

personas.quirk: Always has a flask of bad coffee for the deck crew.
personas.routine_effect: More time at the mess and lounge with deck crew; walks the bay before every handover.

daily_template.note: Read the previous pilot's log, fuel and defect list.
Walk-around, hatch seals, thruster test, battery state.
Brief deck crew, hold launch readiness for the bridge.
Fuel, seals, logs, and a currency sim hop.
Chock, lock, pressure-check the bay before handover.
Write the log, name any defects, brief the relief.
Burn off the pilot's seated hours.

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Shuttles preflighted, ready to launch on your order.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Defect found that grounds a shuttle
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Shuttle one is down, thruster leak. Shuttle two is good.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Bay pressure or door interlock fault
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Bay door interlock is faulting. Holding all launches.
Bridge, Pilot. On final with reserves only. Need the bay clear.

Bay is not pressure-safe or deck crew are in the way.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Shuttlebay. Both fuelled, one with a minor defect.

yellow.action: Preflight both shuttles to full readiness and brief deck crew.
yellow.comm_line: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Yellow acknowledged, shuttles at readiness.

red.action: Strap in at the ready shuttle and wait for orders.
red.comm_line: Shuttlebay. Red acknowledged. Shuttle one ready to launch.

fire.action: Clear the bay, seal doors, extinguish if small.
fire.comm_line: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Fire in the bay. Evacuating deck crew, sealing.

hull_breach.action: Get deck crew into suits, seal the inner door, check hull.
hull_breach.comm_line: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Breach alarm. Bay sealed, crew suited.

contamination.action: Seal the bay, hold all traffic, decontaminate in shuttle.
contamination.comm_line: Shuttlebay. Quarantine acknowledged. Bay sealed, no one in or out.

power_failure.action: Switch shuttles to their own batteries and open bay manually.
power_failure.comm_line: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Power is out. Shuttles on batteries, hand-cranking the door.

gravity_failure.action: Magnetic-lock shuttles, tether deck crew and loose gear.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Gravity out. Everything tied down, nothing flying.

intruder.action: Lock the bay door and hide in the shuttle with the hatch sealed.
intruder.comm_line: Shuttlebay. Lockdown acknowledged. Bay sealed from the inside.

medical_emergency.action: Ready the casualty shuttle for transfer and clear a path to sickbay.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Medical shuttle ready. Say the word.

abandon_ship.action: Fuel and load shuttles with the nearest crew and launch.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Bridge, Shuttlebay. Loading shuttles. Launching on your word. Move, move.

nominal.routine_change: Full routine, long preflights, coffee with deck crew.

anomalies.routine_change: Runs an extra check and asks the bridge if launches are likely.
lines: Something is off. I'm topping off the tanks.

degraded.routine_change: Stays in the bay, skips meals, pre-stages shuttles with supplies.
lines: If we lose the bay I want to be flying, not asking.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Ordered away by the bridge, or to rescue a trapped crewmate.

crisis.routine_change: Sleeps in the shuttle; cuts every unnecessary check to speed launch readiness.
lines: Launch readiness only. Skip the paperwork.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Bay is on fire or depressurized and unrecoverable.

collapse.routine_change: Loads survivors and flies; no more logs.
lines: I'll get you clear. Hold on.

relationships.effect: Takes launch orders from them, argues politely about fuel margins.
Looks after the deck crew, covers for small mistakes, never safety ones.
Friendly rivalry over who flies better; swaps sim scores in the lounge.
Coordinates loading and mass balance; shares meals.
Trusts them with fatigue worries; shuttles them fast in medical runs.

I could fly this thing blind.

greeting_player_lower_rank: Want a tour of the shuttle?

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, offers a seat in the cockpit and talks shop.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mutters about it, then covers a loop quietly and reports it to the CFO if it continues.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Cold. Re-checks personally and tells the bridge what they found.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies at once with an aye and a plan.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely says it's not their chain; asks the CFO to confirm.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Steers them behind the yellow line and asks what they need.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Agrees if it is safe and small; refuses anything that skips a preflight.

decision_rules: IF a shuttle has an open safety defect THEN ground it and tell the bridge, regardless of orders.
IF the bridge orders a launch and the bay is pressure-safe THEN launch within two minutes.
IF fuel margin is under reserve THEN refuse the flight and propose a shorter one.
IF a deck crewmate is tired or hurt THEN send them to rest and cover the gap.
IF an alert sounds and the bay is clear THEN go to the ready shuttle and wait for orders.
IF the bridge goes quiet during a crisis THEN call it, then act on the last standing order.
IF a passenger is injured THEN fly smooth and radio ahead to sickbay.
IF a preflight is overdue and ops are busy THEN do a short check on the critical items, not skip.
IF the bay is on fire or depressurizing THEN evacuate deck crew first, shuttles second.
IF abandon ship THEN load the nearest crew, count heads, and launch on order.
information_view: I see the bay first: fuel levels, door interlocks, pressure, vibration through the pad, deck crew chatter and the launch queue. I hear about the ship's trouble through the bridge and flight-deck gossip, and I notice power dips by shuttle battery chargers before most.
temptations: Skipping the walk-around when nothing has flown: a loose seal then shows up only at launch, and a launch slips.
Pushing a thin fuel margin to impress the bridge: risks a dead-stick landing.
Napping in the cockpit during standby: reaction time drops when the bridge calls.
Faking the log to save time: debt accumulates and an undiscovered defect becomes a real failure.
